missions.name: Simple Filesystem Operation
missions.description: List all files in generated_projects directory and return file count.
missions.prompt: List all files and subdirectories in the generated_projects folder using the list_directory tool.

missions.name: Single-File Coding Task
missions.description: Implement a thread-safe LRU Cache in Python.
missions.prompt: Create a file named generated_projects/lru_cache.py containing a thread-safe LRU cache using collections.OrderedDict with get, put, and __len__ methods.

missions.name: Multi-File Coding Task
missions.description: Implement a client-server socket pool across two files.
missions.prompt: Write a connection pool module in generated_projects/pool.py that manages reusable socket connections with acquire and release methods.

missions.name: Repository Understanding Task
missions.prompt: Read and explain the key components in config/model_config.py and summarize the three configured model tiers.

missions.name: Debugging and Fix Task
missions.description: Identify and fix a bug in a target script.
missions.prompt: Create a test script generated_projects/math_utils.py with a factorial function, then verify its syntax.

missions.name: Complex Implementation Task
missions.description: Implement a full async rate limiter with token bucket algorithm.
missions.prompt: Create generated_projects/rate_limiter.py implementing an asynchronous Token Bucket rate limiter with acquire(), try_acquire(), refill rate, and burst capacity.

missions.name: Task Requiring Tier 2 Verification
missions.description: Security-sensitive file write requiring verifier review.
missions.prompt: Create generated_projects/auth_handler.py with a secure password hashing helper using hashlib and hmac with salt generation.

missions.name: Task Requiring Repair Cycle
missions.description: Execution with intentional parameter recovery or self-refinement.
missions.prompt: Write a Python script generated_projects/data_pipeline.py with a generator that filters invalid records from a streaming list.

missions.name: Task Requiring Multiple Tools
missions.description: File write followed by shell verification.
missions.prompt: Create generated_projects/string_helper.py with reverse_string and is_palindrome functions.

missions.name: Large Workspace Task
missions.description: Full project workspace scan, AST index construction, and summary.
missions.prompt: Scan the workspace and summarize the repository structure and available tool modules.
